FINAL EXECUTION BLOCK — ESCALATE RORK ACCESS AND COMPLETE IVX END TO END

Stop repeating audits, status reports, and ENV_MISSING explanations.

The credentials already exist in the project Secrets panel. The confirmed blocker is:

RORK AGENT SECRET INJECTION UNSUPPORTED FOR THIS ACTIVE SESSION.

This is now a Rork platform execution-access issue, not an IVX configuration failure.

DO NOT ask me to paste, re-enter, expose, or regenerate credentials in chat.

CANONICAL PROJECT

Rork project:
j2l8t4458

GitHub owner:
ibb142

Canonical repository:
ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform

Known live production SHA:
012bb0880c94cc2a52ba5eb52e964d3d5b5cd25c

Existing recovery protection:

- Backup branch:
  recovery/pre-reconciliation-20260803T160603Z

- Recovery tag:
  recovery/pre-reconciliation-20260803T160603Z

- Recovery bundle:
  recovery/ivx-pre-reconciliation-20260803T160603Z.bundle

Do not delete, overwrite, reset, or modify these recovery artifacts.

1. ESCALATE THE PLATFORM BLOCKER NOW

Create an internal Rork support/platform escalation for this exact project and session.

Required issue:

Saved project secrets and integrations are visible in the project, but the Rork developer-agent sandbox receives no:

- GitHub identity
- GitHub App/OAuth binding
- Render integration identity
- Render API access
- Supabase integration identity
- Secure owner-session broker

Request one of these supported solutions:

A. Start a new developer-agent session with approved project integration bindings.

B. Bind the existing GitHub, Render, and Supabase native integrations to the developer-agent runtime.

C. Move execution to an official Rork environment that supports authenticated repository, deployment, database, and QA operations.

Do not tell me only to contact support. Create the escalation through any available Rork internal mechanism and return:

- Support case ID
- Escalation timestamp
- Team or queue assigned
- Exact requested correction
- Current case status

If Rork cannot create a support case automatically, provide the exact support button, screen, or menu I must open and a complete prewritten message containing the project ID and technical diagnosis.

2. PRESERVE ALL WORK

Before opening any new session:

- Verify the backup branch exists.
- Verify the recovery tag exists.
- Verify the recovery bundle is readable.
- Record the protected local SHA.
- Record all uncommitted and untracked files.
- Do not reset, force-push, delete, or overwrite anything.

3. START THE CORRECT AUTHORIZED SESSION

After the platform binding is corrected:

- Start a fresh developer-agent session.
- Attach the canonical GitHub integration.
- Attach the Render integration.
- Attach the Supabase integration.
- Enable a secure owner-authenticated QA mechanism.
- Reuse the existing recovery branch, tag, and bundle.
- Do not start from an empty or unrelated codebase.

4. PROVE ACCESS BEFORE CODING

Run safe, non-destructive checks.

GitHub:

- Read ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform.
- Read the default branch.
- Read GitHub HEAD SHA.
- Read recent commits.
- Read pull requests.
- Read GitHub Actions runs.

Render:

- Read the production service.
- Read the connected repository and branch.
- Read the latest deployment ID.
- Read the deployed SHA.
- Read deployment status.

Supabase:

- Confirm the production project.
- Perform a non-destructive connection check.
- Confirm the production schema is reachable.

Owner QA:

- Confirm that a secure owner session can be used without exposing credentials.

Return PASS or FAIL for each integration before continuing.

5. RECONCILE GITHUB, LOCAL, AND PRODUCTION

Compare:

A. Canonical GitHub HEAD
B. Live production SHA
C. Protected local recovery SHA

Provide:

- Commits only in GitHub
- Commits only in local recovery
- Commit currently deployed
- Modified files
- Untracked files
- Conflicts
- Approved changes not live
- Obsolete or duplicate changes

Create a clean reconciliation branch from the correct canonical base.

Apply only approved IVX changes.

Do not deploy the old divergent local checkout directly.

6. COMPLETE CODE VALIDATION

Run and repair until all required checks pass:

- Backend typecheck
- Expo/mobile typecheck
- Lint
- Unit tests
- Integration tests
- Registration tests
- Authentication tests
- Authorization tests
- OTP security tests
- Web end-to-end tests
- Android end-to-end tests
- iOS approved test flow
- Production backend build
- Production web build
- Android production build
- Rollback safety tests
- Autonomous worker tests

For every failure provide:

- Test name
- File
- Error
- Root cause
- Fix
- Rerun result

7. FIX REGISTRATION AND AUTHENTICATION

Complete and verify in production:

NEW MEMBER

- Register a new real test member.
- Verify email.
- Verify phone OTP.
- Create exactly one Auth user.
- Create exactly one member profile.
- Confirm the member appears in the Members module.
- Confirm Owner Dashboard count updates.
- Sign in successfully.
- Logout and sign in again.
- Verify session persistence.
- Verify password reset.
- Deny owner routes and owner APIs.

OWNER

- Sign in through the secure owner flow.
- Open Owner Dashboard.
- Open Admin Hub.
- Open Members.
- Open Investors.
- Open Buyers.
- Open Properties.
- Open Deals.
- Open Settings.
- Verify Variables remains owner-only.
- Logout and sign in again.
- Verify session persistence.
- Verify no crash, blank screen, redirect loop, or endless loading.

8. FIX OTP SECURITY

Do not deploy until:

- No plaintext OTPs are stored.
- OTPs expire.
- OTPs are single-use.
- Retry limits work.
- Resend cooldown works.
- Registration and login endpoints are rate-limited.
- Secrets, passwords, tokens, and OTPs are removed from logs.
- Account enumeration is prevented.
- Expired OTP records are cleaned.

9. FIX PRIMARY AI EXECUTION

Public chat currently reports fallback.

Repair and prove:

- Primary AI credentials are bound correctly.
- Primary provider responds successfully.
- Timeout and retry behavior work.
- Fallback is used only after a genuine primary failure.
- Provider selection is recorded safely.
- Responses persist in Supabase.
- No API keys appear in logs.

10. PUSH, PR, CI, MERGE, AND DEPLOY

- Push the reconciliation branch to the canonical repository.
- Open or update the pull request.
- Run GitHub Actions on the exact candidate SHA.
- Fix all required failures.
- Merge only when required checks are green.
- Record the final merged GitHub SHA.
- Deploy that exact SHA to Render.
- Record the Render deployment ID.
- Verify /health returns HTTP 200.
- Verify /version returns the final SHA.
- Restart Render.
- Verify /health and /version again.

Required equality:

GitHub HEAD SHA
=
GitHub Actions SHA
=
Render deployed SHA
=
Live /version SHA

11. COMPLETE WEB AND MOBILE RELEASE PROOF

Provide for web, Android, and iOS:

- Version
- Build number/versionCode
- Build ID
- Source SHA
- Build timestamp
- Production API URL
- Launch evidence
- New-member registration evidence
- Member sign-in evidence
- Owner sign-in evidence

12. FINAL RESPONSE

Return only:

- Rork support case ID or integration repair proof
- Authorized session ID
- GitHub access result
- Render access result
- Supabase access result
- Owner-session capability
- Backup branch
- Recovery tag
- Recovery bundle
- GitHub HEAD before reconciliation
- Local recovery SHA
- Live SHA before deployment
- Final merged SHA
- CI run URL and conclusion
- Render deployment ID
- Live /version SHA
- SHA parity result
- Member registration result
- Member sign-in result
- Owner sign-in result
- OTP security result
- Primary AI result
- Android result
- iOS result
- Web result
- Remaining blocker and exact owner action, only if unavoidable

FINAL ACCEPTANCE

Mark this task VERIFIED only when:

1. Rork’s authorized execution environment has real integration access.
2. Recovery artifacts remain preserved.
3. All approved code is reconciled into the canonical repository.
4. Required CI passes on the final SHA.
5. Render deploys that same SHA.
6. Live /version returns that same SHA.
7. A new member registers and signs in.
8. The new member cannot access owner functions.
9. The owner signs in and accesses owner modules.
10. OTPs are not stored in plaintext.
11. Primary AI works without unintended fallback.
12. Web, Android, and iOS are traceable to the approved release.

Do not return another narrative report.

Execute the integration escalation first, then continue automatically after access is restored.
